svg.aria-label: CVM entity-relationship diagram under the frames-as-objects design. Six tables grouped into: cvm marker (gray), object graph (objects and refs, teal), listeners (instance_listeners and class_listeners, purple), and execution (processes, green). Frames are not a separate table — a frame is an `objects` row with primitive = 'f' (biconditional with the ast column, which carries the code the frame is executing). Foreign keys drawn as curved gray lines with arrowheads. Self-referential foreign keys are drawn as small self-loop arrows on the source column.
svg.title: CVM schema — entity-relationship diagram
